question: The Commonwealth Games 2018 were held at which of the following places?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gold Coast.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 2018 Commonwealth Games**, officially known as the XXI Commonwealth Games, was an international multi-sport event for the members of the commonwealth that were held at **Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia between 4 & 15 April 2018.**
 
• There were **18 sports categories.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **Birmingham **will host** Commonwealth Games in 2022.**
 
• The Commonwealth Games is an international multi-sport event that was** first held in 1930. **
 
• The 2022 Commonwealth Games is officially known as the XXII Commonwealth Games.
 
• The Games are expected to take place between 28 July and 8 August 2022.
 
• It will be the third time England will host the** Commonwealth Games, after London in 1934 and** **Manchester in 2002**.
 
• The Birmingham Organising Committee for the 2022 Commonwealth Games is responsible for the planning and operational delivery of the Games. 
 
• This includes **sport, venue and competition management, ticket sales, all ceremonies, and the Queen’s Baton Relay. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Why It is called Commonwealth** 

 
 
• The Commonwealth is a collection of countries that are linked in some way to Great Britain, all apart from Mozambique.
 
• Since the Game started the game has taken place every four years except for 1942 and 1946, because of World war - II.
